summary: SWR (stale-while-revalidate) implementation for İptal Detay modal fully verified. BACKEND (pytest, 5/5 pass): (1) missing iptal_id → 400 'gerekli' ✓; (2) missing tenant_id → 400 ✓; (3) cache-only POST /api/data/iptal-detail returns in ~2s with valid {ok, data:[], header:{}} shape ✓; (4) allow_fetch=true returns 200 with valid JSON — NOT 500 — SWR revalidate log 'SWR POS fetch failed IPTAL_ID=1: 504' fires as expected when POS offline (fresh POS call attempted, exception caught, cached result returned); (5) alt tenant d5587c87a7f9476fa82b83f40accd6c7 cache-only → 200. FRONTEND (Playwright, 375x667 mobile viewport): logged in as cakmak_ebubekir@hotmail.com/admin (works; the other credential still 401), injected @notification_pending_tap_v2 with type=line_cancellation, tenant=eecd5678f55d4db88e15230d70718a02, iptal_id=1, reloaded → Fiş İptal modal opens within ~800ms with red header, #1, İPTAL ₺0,00, 0 kalem, and empty-state 'Detay satırı bulunamadı'. Modal DID NOT get stuck on the full-screen 'İptal detayı yükleniyor…' spinner, DID NOT crash, and pending tap was cleared from localStorage. Close (X) button at header top-right (coords 360,35) closes the modal and dashboard remains functional. IMPORTANT PERFORMANCE OBSERVATION: allow_fetch=true SWR revalidate on backend takes ~58s in this run (POS iptal_id=1 not real / offline) even though _on_demand_request is called with timeout_sec=20 — the effective end-to-end time exceeds the ~25s target from the spec. Backend still returns 200 with cached shell, so UX is not broken, but user staring at the 'Ürün detayları POS'tan getiriliyor…' spinner may see it for up to a minute on cold real-iptal lookups. NOTE: no real IPTAL_ID was available today via /api/data/iptal-list (empty rows), so the SWR spinner text was not visible in my snapshot windows — for this synthetic id=1 with empty cache the refreshing→empty transition happens fast enough that the spinner did not linger past 800ms.

minor.issue: SWR revalidate end-to-end takes ~58-60s when POS is offline/no such iptal_id, even though _on_demand_request is invoked with timeout_sec=20. Spec target is ~25s. Not a 5xx (endpoint gracefully returns cached shell), but the frontend spinner 'Ürün detayları POS'tan getiriliyor…' will stay on-screen for up to a minute on cold lookups. Suggest wrapping the SWR revalidate in an asyncio.wait_for(fresh, timeout=25) or lowering the inner poll budget so the endpoint gives up sooner and returns cached data.

data.py L1477 correctly reads allow_fetch from body; L1643-1660 correctly gates SWR revalidate on `not line_items and allow_fetch`, uses skip_mysql_cache=True to force fresh POS call, catches exceptions so 504 doesn't propagate as 500.
